contract: Frozen VAMM contract v2 and docs/MVP.md: a student explores five routes, previews and commits three annual savings turns from zero, explicitly funds shocks, and resets without erasing history. Warm, calm workspace for ages 15–18; primary action is advancing a validated annual turn. No stock trading, additional stores or live-news scope.

accessibility.evidence: Observed keyboard Tab to visible skip link, Enter focus transfer to main, labeled research/funding controls, text alongside sentiment/chart color, and reduced-motion spinner animation:none. Computed rendered text-contrast checks found zero failures across 16 screen/state/viewport combinations; chart colors were darkened for graphical contrast. Actual range and checkbox-label heights were at least 44 CSS px. These are scoped checks, not exhaustive assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: Chromium checks at 1440x900 and 390x844 rendered all five routes without document overflow or page errors. Explicit funding and completed-turn screens also fit; tables scroll within their containers. Desktop sidebar and horizontally scrolling mobile navigation were inspected in screenshots.

loading.evidence: A deliberately delayed market response displayed Loading the educational baskets; reduced-motion disabled spinner animation. Manual retry after a simulated503 restored the baskets.

empty.evidence: A fresh local profile displayed the explicit start-session state; a mocked empty news response displayed No teaching stories are available.

error.evidence: Simulated503 and unavailable IndexedDB displayed specific alerts. Retry recovered market data; unavailable storage disabled session creation and never silently reset history.

partial.evidence: Both comparison annual-fee cells displayed Unavailable with the frozen explanation while cumulative-return metrics remained available.

success.evidence: Production-browser tests completed all three funded turns, checked version6, retained three history rows, reset to a second zero-balance session, and verified prior records survived reload. Two tabs competing against version0 produced one pending turn and a visible conflict.

permission.evidence: The simulated browser-storage access boundary displayed Local storage is unavailable and a safe reload action; start was disabled. Device-sharing limits are visible on desktop/mobile. No account/auth permission flow was added.

renderedEvidence.observation: Final production dashboard: navigation, three exact synthetic baskets, dated index chart and provenance.
Final production mobile dashboard: wrapped text, contained chart/navigation and visible device disclosure.
Three settled annual turns, nominal/real balances, prewritten reflection and separate contribution/gain/bill history.
Pending bill is separate from undeducted holdings; explicit funding and acknowledgment controls fit the viewport.

limitations: The preserved-session navigation index is in QueryClient memory; prior records remain in IndexedDB across refresh, while the frozen gateway has no operation to enumerate all old session IDs.
Model/provider service access was not configured or exercised; provider failures use labeled fixtures.
Research rate/concurrency limits are per instance, not a distributed billing quota.
